title: glechoma nepalensis
intro: Glechoma nepalensis, commonly known as Nepal mint or Nepal lemongrass, is a plant species that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and offers various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma nepalensis include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
